arStrings.szText:
Your Shapeshifting Skills deal {c_number}[{SF_3}*100|x%|]{/c} more damage.

After dealing Damage with a Shapeshifting Skill, your Spirit costs are reduced by {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_0}*100*{SF_1}|%|]{/c}. 

After you Shapeshift, this bonus resets and reduces the Cooldown of your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill by that many seconds.
You have {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|%|]{/c} reduced Spirit costs per stack.
